messages.Select Timeline Members: Enter a name and select at least one team or user.
messages.Timeline Members Help: Include everyone in selected teams, specific people, or both. Team membership updates when the timeline refreshes.
messages.Could not load shared calendar: Could not load the shared calendar. Try refreshing.
messages.No calendar users: No active users available for this calendar.
messages.All calendar people hidden: Everyone is hidden. Select a person above or choose Show all.
messages.Select Calendar Members: Enter a name, choose a calendar type, and select at least one team or person.
messages.Could not update event: Could not update this event. Check your permissions and try again.
messages.Could not save view settings: Could not save calendar view settings. Please try again.
messages.Calendar Membership Help: Dynamic calendars resolve the current team members on every refresh. Static calendars capture the selected teams and users when you save. Later team changes do not change that list. Saving a static calendar again refreshes its captured list. Show inactive users and calendar permissions still apply.
messages.Static Calendar Member Limit: A static calendar can include up to 500 users. Select fewer teams or users, or use dynamic membership.
messages.Could not capture calendar members: Could not capture the calendar members. No calendar changes were saved. Please try again.
messages.Invalid visible time range: Enter a valid time range, such as 08:00 to 15:00. The end must be later than the start; use 24:00 for the end of the day.
messages.Invalid search dates: Enter a valid date range with the end on or after the start.
messages.Could not search calendar: Could not search calendar events. Please try again.
messages.Search partial results: Some event types could not be searched. Available results are shown.
messages.Search calendar visibility: Show in calendar is available for events belonging to loaded calendar users. Selecting a result temporarily reveals it without changing saved filters.
messages.Could not save search options: Could not save search result options. Please try again.
messages.Search result user not loaded: This event does not belong to a user loaded in the selected calendar.
messages.Search result has no date: This event has no date to show in the calendar.
